C1140.title: Behavioral Study of NFT Rug-Pull Creators
C1140.summary: On October 11, 2023, Trishie Sharma, Rachit Agarwal, and Sandeep Kumar Shukla published a study in ACM Transactions on the Web. The team analyzed 760 rug pulls across ten NFT marketplaces, classified projects into twenty groups based on links among creator accounts, and found that one creator attempted thirty-seven rug pulls within three months.
